description: This file contains an assertion class for testing the responses of the 'ThingQueryCommand'. It provides methods to verify properties such as resource path, headers, type, status, and entity within the response object, used mainly in unit testing scenarios.

classes.name: ThingQueryCommandResponseAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class extending from AbstractCommandResponseAssert, providing specialized methods for asserting properties of ThingQueryCommandResponse objects, such as resource path, headers, type, status, and entity.

methods.name: ThingQueryCommandResponseAssert
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the assertion object with the actual response.

methods.name: withType
methods.description: Asserts that the response has the expected type.

methods.name: withDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the response has the expected Ditto headers.

methods.name: withResourcePath
methods.description: Overloaded method: Asserts that the response's resource path matches the expected path, with optional further segments.

methods.name: withResourcePath
methods.description: Overloaded method: Asserts resource path with a JsonPointer combining main path and further segments.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Asserts that the response has the expected HTTP status code.

methods.name: withEntity
methods.description: Asserts that the response has the expected JSON entity.
